notes.title: Chaos Texture Games Plays The Intermine Legacy: I am the Darkness!
notes.content:
In celebration of [b]The Intermine Legacy: I am the Darkness[/b] being included in Steam Next Fest, the creative director, writer and programmer James David Herd/pixcelation will be hosting a behind-the-scenes livestream where he'll play the currently available demo and quite possibly unveil some new info!

Here is a synopsis of [b]The Intermine Legacy: I am the Darkness[/b] —

[b]The Intermine Legacy: I am the Darkness[/b] follows Joseph McPherson, Eric Eastwick, and William McKinley (as well as a handful of other supporting characters) as they inexplicably awake from cryogenic stasis at the enigmatic facility known as Intermine Laboratories. But, deep within the abyss exists an ancient evil that is seeking to manipulate the residents of Intermine Laboratories for its own twisted machinations.

[b]The Intermine Legacy: I am the Darkness[/b] is the debut visual novel by Chaos Texture Games. If you would like more information about the game or its story as it develops, check out any of the following links:
